state.seed_assertion: To assess whether something is high risk, you need to consider both the likelihood and severity of any potential harm to individuals.

sentences.1: To assess whether something is high risk, you need to consider both the likelihood and severity of any potential harm to individuals.
sentences.2: To assess whether something is 'high risk', the UK GDPR is clear that you need to consider both the likelihood and severity of any potential harm to individuals.
sentences.3: Where necessary, the controller must carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.4: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.5: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.6: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.7: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.8: If the processing is wholly or partly performed by a data processor, the processor should assist the controller in carrying out the DPIA and provide any necessary information in line with Article 28(3)(f).
